title: Is Keeping Your Old Car Better For The Environment?
summary: Engineering Explained compares the lifecycle emissions of keeping an old car with those of buying a new, more efficient one. It weighs manufacturing emissions against emissions from driving, and covers gas versus electric cars.
why: HN commenters cite it in EV and emissions debates for its numbers on when replacing a car pays off.

quote.text: Skip to 6 minutes in the video for when he starts showing compiled data of when its better to buy a new car vs keep old.
